name: Hub API Server
description: Inter-app message hub. Apps register with the hub on startup, exchange async messages, and declare data they expose. Runs as part of the launcher binary on localhost:7700; this manifest enables the UI to show its status in the module dashboard.

install._note: The Hub server ships with the launcher binary (src-tauri/src/hub/). This module entry exists so the launcher UI can surface its health in the dashboard and so future Hub upgrades can be delivered through the manifest.

settings.description: Default 7700. Change if you have a port conflict.

runtime._note: command=builtin:hub is a sentinel — the launcher never spawns an external process; it already owns the hub.

uninstall._note: Cannot be uninstalled independently of the launcher.

provides.description: POST /apps/register, GET /apps, POST /messages, GET /messages/{app_id}, POST /data/register, GET /data/catalog, GET /health
